## KEY FEATURES & SPECIFICATIONS

### 4X4 Drive System
- On-demand all-wheel drive capability
- Dual independent 6.3kW motors
- Handles hills, mud, sand, gravel, and rough terrain
- Electronic traction control
- Regenerative braking system

### Electric Power
- Zero emissions, eco-friendly operation
- 50+ mile range on single charge
- Standard 110V charging capability
- Fast charge options available
- Maintenance-free lithium batteries

### Street Legal (LSV) Features
- DOT-approved headlights and taillights
- Turn signals and hazard lights
- Side mirrors and rearview mirror
- Three-point seatbelts
- Horn and windshield wipers
- VIN number for registration

### Luxury Amenities

- Built-in refrigerator/cooler

- USB charging ports
- Cup holders throughout
- Under-seat storage

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: Are EVolution golf carts street legal?
A: Yes, when equipped with LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) features including lights, signals, mirrors, and seatbelts. Registration requirements vary by state.

Q: What is the range of the D-MAX models?
A: Both XT4 and XT6 models achieve 50+ miles on a single charge under normal operating conditions.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, financing options are available for qualified buyers. Contact us for details.

Q: What warranty is included?
A: All EVolution golf carts include a comprehensive manufacturer warranty covering major components.

Q: Do you deliver nationwide?
A: Yes, we offer delivery throughout the United States including Alaska, Hawaii, and U.S. territories.

Q: What terrain can the 4X4 handle?
A: The dual-motor 4X4 system handles hills, mud, sand, gravel, grass, and most off-road conditions.
